name: Spenta International Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Spenta International 
Ltd specializes in designing, manufacturing and exporting cotton socks for men, women and children.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Women Sports 
b) Women Fashion 
c) Women Socks
d) Kids Socks
e) Wrist Bands
f) Men Formals
g) Men Sports
h) Technical Socks

pros: Stock is trading at 0.83 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 24.0%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 58.8 days to 43.1 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.69% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.16% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.97 Cr.
